leadText:
(Japanese: センタ Senta) is a character of the day who appeared in Fit To Be Tide. He is Cissy's assistant and younger brother. He was not given a name in the English dub.

Senta lives on Mikan Island with his sister. He is known for playing practical jokes on visitors to the Mikan Gym, including . He thinks very highly of his sister and the rest of the s in the Orange Crew. Even when Ash informed him of his placing in the Indigo League, Senta told him to not even compete in the Orange League, saying it was tougher unless he was an elite Trainer.
